critical_code_review_comments: Minor/non-blocking: service-run.bat calls start-mongo.bat with `>> service.log`; when start-mongo launches mongod via `start`, mongod may inherit the redirected service.log handle, which can make the 5MB service.log `move` rotation fail silently (log keeps growing). Optional fix: launch mongod with its own redirection, e.g. `start "MecSmart - MongoDB" /min cmd /c ""%MONGOD%" ... >nul 2>&1"`, or prefer the MongoDB Windows service.
Minor: stop-erp --with-mongo only kills mongod launched with window title 'MecSmart - MongoDB' or the 'MongoDB' Windows service; a manually started mongod is not stopped (acceptable).
